about: Expected answers of the Process4 tool (design 8) to the 150 recorded changes of the notice's proof, converted to the Process4 forms in this folder.

For each change: told, each told user with, briefly, its reasons (provider, entry and words, or "not followed fully", and the note of an undeclared use); refuses, the modules from the provider on whose check refuses after the change; firstCommentsStep where the change is a module's comments-only first step.

Started from the proof's recorded design-7 answers (results/iter7/<series>/<id>.json, as its tool said them; changes/iter7/<series>-expected.json and -reading.json). Where design 8 answers differently, the answer is recorded again and each difference has one line in rerecorded, saying which rule of design 7 it rested on.
needs is the proof's reading of which users truly needed a change (changes/iter7/<series>-reading.json), kept to show where design 8 misses one that design 7 told or stopped.
